method: Read-only source follow-up; not supplied to the already frozen factorial experiment.
findings: Target exposes map_gsi_pin_to. Do not infer complete absence of legacy interrupt facilities from missing PCI wrapper.
map_gsi_pin_to delegates to ioapic.enable; the non-remapped path writes the IRQ vector directly into the redirection low word.
The inspected entry programming does not expose polarity/trigger parameters. PCI pin routing, sharing and level-trigger semantics remain to be established.
No runtime tests or target patches performed; this is a hypothesis-directed source audit, not a verified e1000 integration route.
